	•	springboard now passes in the regime-aware execution line when probe_r1_only is used

```
53. def accuracy_score(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray) -> float:

57. def confusion_matrix(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, labels: list[str]) -> list[list[int]]:
58.     index = {label: i for i, label in enumerate(labels)}
59.     matrix = np.zeros((len(labels), len(labels)), dtype=int)
60.     for truth, pred in zip(y_true, y_pred):
61.         matrix[index[str(truth)]][index[str(pred)]] += 1
62.     return matrix.tolist()

65. def precision_recall_f1(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, label: str) -> dict[str, float]:
66.     tp = int(np.sum((y_true == label) & (y_pred == label)))
67.     fp = int(np.sum((y_true != label) & (y_pred == label)))
68.     fn = int(np.sum((y_true == label) & (y_pred != label)))
69.     precision = tp / (tp + fp) if tp + fp else 0.0
70.     recall = tp / (tp + fn) if tp + fn else 0.0
71.     f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0
72.     return {"precision": precision, "recall": recall, "f1": f1, "support": tp + fn}
73.

75. def macro_metrics(y_true: np.ndarray, y_pred: np.ndarray, labels: list[str]) -> dict[str, float]:
76.     prfs = [precision_recall_f1(y_true, y_pred, label) for label in labels]
77.     return {
78.         "precision": float(np.mean([item["precision"] for item in prfs])) if prfs else 0.0,
79.         "recall": float(np.mean([item["recall"] for item in prfs])) if prfs else 0.0,
80.         "f1": float(np.mean([item["f1"] for item in prfs])) if prfs else 0.0,
81.     }

84. def binary_auc(y_true: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray, positive_label: str) -> float:
85.     pos = scores[y_true == positive_label]
86.     neg = scores[y_true != positive_label]
87.     total = len(pos) * len(neg)
88.     if total == 0:
89.         return 0.5
90.     gt = 0
91.     eq = 0
92.     for value in pos:
93.         diff = value - neg
94.         gt += int(np.sum(diff > 0))
95.         eq += int(np.sum(diff == 0))
96.     auc = (gt + 0.5 * eq) / total
97.     return float(max(auc, 1.0 - auc))

102.     std = x.std(axis=0)
103.     std[std < 1e-8] = 1.0

111. def softmax(z: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
112.     z = z - np.max(z, axis=1, keepdims=True)
113.     exp = np.exp(np.clip(z, -40.0, 40.0))
114.     return exp / np.maximum(exp.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-12)

117. def train_multinomial_logreg(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, class_names: list[str], epochs: int = 1200, lr: float = 0.08, l2: float = 0.01) -> dict:
118.     n_samples, n_features = x.shape
119.     n_classes = len(class_names)
120.     weights = np.zeros((n_classes, n_features), dtype=np.float64)
121.     bias = np.zeros(n_classes, dtype=np.float64)
122.     for _ in range(epochs):
123.         logits = x @ weights.T + bias
124.         probs = softmax(logits)
125.         target = np.zeros_like(probs)
126.         target[np.arange(n_samples), y] = 1.0
127.         error = probs - target
128.         grad_w = error.T @ x / n_samples + l2 * weights
129.         grad_b = error.mean(axis=0)
130.         weights -= lr * grad_w
131.         bias -= lr * grad_b
132.     return {"weights": weights, "bias": bias, "classes": class_names}
133. 
134. 
135. def predict_multinomial(model: dict, x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
136.     logits = x @ model["weights"].T + model["bias"]
137.     probs = softmax(logits)
138.     pred = np.argmax(probs, axis=1)
139.     return pred, probs
140. 
141. 
142. def train_binary_logreg(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, epochs: int = 1000, lr: float = 0.1, l2: float = 0.01) -> dict:
143.     n_samples, n_features = x.shape
144.     weights = np.zeros(n_features, dtype=np.float64)
145.     bias = 0.0
146.     for _ in range(epochs):
147.         logits = x @ weights + bias
148.         probs = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))
149.         error = probs - y
150.         grad_w = (x.T @ error) / n_samples + l2 * weights
151.         grad_b = float(np.mean(error))
152.         weights -= lr * grad_w
153.         bias -= lr * grad_b
154.     return {"weights": weights, "bias": bias}
155. 
156. 
157. def predict_binary_logreg(model: dict, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
158.     logits = x @ model["weights"] + model["bias"]
159.     return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))

178.         1.0 if row.get("session_type") == "springboard" else 0.0,
179.         1.0 if row.get("session_type") == "platform" else 0.0,
180.         1.0 if row.get("event_label_provenance") == "session_type_inferred" else 0.0,
181.         1.0 if row.get("event_label_provenance") == "subtype_mapped" else 0.0,

183.     ]

186. def collect_dataset(rows: list[dict], strict: bool) -> list[dict]:
187.     selected = []
188.     for row in rows:
189.         if strict:
190.             if row.get("session_type_provenance") != "direct_review":
191.                 continue
192.         else:

195.         selected.append(row)

199. def split_by_session(rows: list[dict]) -> list[tuple[str, list[dict], list[dict]]]:
200.     by_session: dict[str, list[dict]] = defaultdict(list)
201.     for row in rows:
202.         by_session[str(row["source_session_id"])].append(row)
203.     sessions = sorted(by_session)
204.     splits = []
205.     for held_out in sessions:
206.         train = [row for sid, subset in by_session.items() if sid != held_out for row in subset]
207.         test = list(by_session[held_out])
208.         splits.append((held_out, train, test))
209.     return splits

212. def train_eval_four_class(train_rows: list[dict], test_rows: list[dict], labels: list[str]) -> dict:
213.     x_train = np.asarray([feature_vector(row) for row in train_rows], dtype=np.float64)
214.     x_test = np.asarray([feature_vector(row) for row in test_rows], dtype=np.float64)
215.     y_train = np.asarray([labels.index(event_label_for_row(row)) for row in train_rows], dtype=int)
216.     y_test = np.asarray([labels.index(event_label_for_row(row)) for row in test_rows], dtype=int)
217.     mean, std = standardize_fit(x_train)
218.     x_train = standardize_apply(x_train, mean, std)
219.     x_test = standardize_apply(x_test, mean, std)
220.     model = train_multinomial_logreg(x_train, y_train, labels)
221.     pred_idx, probs = predict_multinomial(model, x_test)
222.     pred = np.asarray([labels[i] for i in pred_idx], dtype=object)
223.     truth = np.asarray([labels[i] for i in y_test], dtype=object)
224.     return {
225.         "accuracy": accuracy_score(truth, pred),
226.         "macro": macro_metrics(truth, pred, labels),
227.         "confusion_matrix": confusion_matrix(truth, pred, labels),
228.         "per_class": {label: precision_recall_f1(truth, pred, label) for label in labels},
229.         "predictions": pred.tolist(),
230.         "truth": truth.tolist(),
231.         "probabilities": probs.tolist(),
232.     }
233.

235. def train_eval_binary(train_rows: list[dict], test_rows: list[dict], positive: str, negative: str) -> dict:
236.     subset_train = [row for row in train_rows if event_label_for_row(row) in {positive, negative}]
237.     subset_test = [row for row in test_rows if event_label_for_row(row) in {positive, negative}]
238.     x_train = np.asarray([feature_vector(row) for row in subset_train], dtype=np.float64)
239.     x_test = np.asarray([feature_vector(row) for row in subset_test], dtype=np.float64)
240.     y_train = np.asarray([1 if event_label_for_row(row) == positive else 0 for row in subset_train], dtype=np.float64)
241.     y_test = np.asarray([1 if event_label_for_row(row) == positive else 0 for row in subset_test], dtype=object)
242.     mean, std = standardize_fit(x_train)
243.     x_train = standardize_apply(x_train, mean, std)
244.     x_test = standardize_apply(x_test, mean, std)
245.     model = train_binary_logreg(x_train, y_train)
246.     scores = predict_binary_logreg(model, x_test)
247.     pred = np.asarray([positive if score >= 0.5 else negative for score in scores], dtype=object)
248.     truth = np.asarray([positive if event_label_for_row(row) == positive else negative for row in subset_test], dtype=object)
249.     return {
250.         "train_count": len(subset_train),
251.         "test_count": len(subset_test),
252.         "accuracy": accuracy_score(truth, pred),
253.         "macro": macro_metrics(truth, pred, [positive, negative]),
254.         "per_class": {label: precision_recall_f1(truth, pred, label) for label in [positive, negative]},
255.         "auc": binary_auc(truth, scores, positive),
256.         "confusion_matrix": confusion_matrix(truth, pred, [positive, negative]),
257.     }
```

$ cd /Users/mcauchy/divesensei-app && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, importlib.util, numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
# load benchmark module
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ecb','benchmarks/event_classifier_baseline.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

manifest=json.load(open('outputs/phase5_regime_manifest_lists.json'))
train_keys=set(r['row_key'] for r in manifest['platform_noise_track']['train_rows'])
holdout=manifest['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows']
holdout_keys=[r['row_key'] for r in holdout]

# load source reviewed manifest rows
rows=[]
for p in [
 'outputs/evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui/exports/event-reviewed-manifest/event_reviewed_manifest.jsonl',
 'outputs/evaluation_insep_15min_validated/exports/event-reviewed-manifest/event_reviewed_manifest.jsonl',
 'outputs/evaluation_champigny_20260406-labelling/exports/event-reviewed-manifest/event_reviewed_manifest.jsonl']:
    for line in open(p):
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        r=json.loads(line)
        rk=f"{r.get('source_session_id')}::{r.get('candidate_id')}"
        r['_row_key']=rk
        rows.append(r)
by={r['_row_key']:r for r in rows}
missing=[k for k in train_keys|set(holdout_keys) if k not in by]
print('missing',len(missing))
if missing:
    print(missing[:10])

train_rows=[by[k] for k in train_keys]
test_rows=[by[k] for k in holdout_keys]

res=m.train_eval_binary(train_rows,test_rows,'platform_dive','noise_or_other')
print('accuracy',res['accuracy'])
print('auc',res['auc'])
print('macro_f1',res['macro']['f1'])
print('cm',res['confusion_matrix'])
# per-row preds
# replicate standardized + model to get scores/preds aligned to holdout_keys order
subset_train=[r for r in train_rows if m.event_label_for_row(r) in {'platform_dive','noise_or_other'}]
subset_test=[r for r in test_rows if m.event_label_for_row(r) in {'platform_dive','noise_or_other'}]
Xtr=np.asarray([m.feature_vector(r) for r in subset_train],dtype=float)
Xte=np.asarray([m.feature_vector(r) for r in subset_test],dtype=float)
ytr=np.asarray([1 if m.event_label_for_row(r)=='platform_dive' else 0 for r in subset_train],dtype=float)
mean,std=m.standardize_fit(Xtr)
Xtr=m.standardize_apply(Xtr,mean,std)
Xte=m.standardize_apply(Xte,mean,std)
model=m.train_binary_logreg(Xtr,ytr)
scores=m.predict_binary_logreg(model,Xte)
for r,s in zip(subset_test,scores):
    pred='platform_dive' if s>=0.5 else 'noise_or_other'
    print(r['_row_key'],m.event_label_for_row(r),pred,round(float(s),4),r.get('legacy_subtype'),r.get('suggestion_reason'),r.get('event_anchor_strategy'))

<sub>⏱️ 13m 30s</sub>

### ✅ `bash`

**Evaluate frozen platform/noise train-holdout using baseline binary model**

$ cd /Users/mcauchy/divesensei-app && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, importlib.util, numpy as np
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('ecb','benchmarks/event_classifier_baseline.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

# load manifest rows and reconstruct keys
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/event_window_manifest_preview.jsonl') if l.strip()]
counts={}
by={}
for r in rows:
    sid=r['source_session_id']
    counts[sid]=counts.get(sid,0)+1
    cid=r.get('legacy_candidate_id')
    rid=cid if cid else f"row-{counts[sid]:04d}"
    by[f"{sid}::{rid}"]=r

manifest=json.load(open('outputs/phase5_regime_manifest_lists.json'))
train_keys=[r['row_key'] for r in manifest['platform_noise_track']['train_rows']]
holdout_rows=manifest['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows']
holdout_keys=[r['row_key'] for r in holdout_rows]
train=[by[k] for k in train_keys]
test=[by[k] for k in holdout_keys]
res=m.train_eval_binary(train,test,'platform_dive','noise_or_other')
print('metrics',res['accuracy'],res['auc'],res['macro']['f1'],res['confusion_matrix'])

# compute aligned predictions with score
subset_train=[r for r in train if m.event_label_for_row(r) in {'platform_dive','noise_or_other'}]
subset_test=[r for r in test if m.event_label_for_row(r) in {'platform_dive','noise_or_other'}]
Xtr=np.asarray([m.feature_vector(r) for r in subset_train],dtype=np.float64)
Xte=np.asarray([m.feature_vector(r) for r in subset_test],dtype=np.float64)
ytr=np.asarray([1 if m.event_label_for_row(r)=='platform_dive' else 0 for r in subset_train],dtype=np.float64)
mean,std=m.standardize_fit(Xtr)
Xtr=m.standardize_apply(Xtr,mean,std)
Xte=m.standardize_apply(Xte,mean,std)
model=m.train_binary_logreg(Xtr,ytr)
scores=m.predict_binary_logreg(model,Xte)

fn=[]; fp=[]
for key,row,score in zip(holdout_keys,subset_test,scores):
    truth=m.event_label_for_row(row)
    pred='platform_dive' if score>=0.5 else 'noise_or_other'
    if truth=='platform_dive' and pred=='noise_or_other': fn.append((key,float(score)))
    if truth=='noise_or_other' and pred=='platform_dive': fp.append((key,float(score)))
print('FN',len(fn),fn)
print('FP',len(fp),fp)

```
# HANDOFF 2026-04-13 — Phase5 r4, Platform/Noise Next

## 1) Current project state

- Frozen validated detector remains unchanged.
- Event taxonomy remains unchanged: `springboard_dive`, `springboard_rebound_only`, `platform_dive`, `noise_or_other`.
- Springboard feature probe r1 transferred successfully into r3/r4.
- Platform/noise scored slice was recovered in r4 (valid two-class holdout with leak prevention).
- Platform/noise still failed as a **real scored modeling problem**.

## 2) Key r4 facts

### Springboard (pass)

- AUC: `0.7745098039215687`
- macro F1: `0.5047619047619047`

- Status: **PASS** (all springboard success guardbands pass)

### Platform/noise (scored fail)

- Holdout slice size: `20`
- Label balance: `10 platform_dive`, `10 noise_or_other`

- Confusion matrix: `[[8, 2], [9, 1]]`
- AUC: `0.51`
- macro F1: `0.37321937321937326`
- Status: **FAIL** (fails platform/noise success guardbands)

### Global interpretation

- **Springboard pass + platform/noise scored failure**
- Global Phase 5 remains fail because platform/noise is not yet good enough.

## 3) What is closed

- Old detector-line experimentation
- Manifest propagation debugging
- Mixed-slice gating ambiguity as primary blocker
- Springboard anchor as primary issue
- Small springboard model-capacity tweak
- Springboard feature probe r2 (explicitly rejected)

## 4) What is active

- Platform/noise false-positive problem
- Especially `noise_or_other -> platform_dive`
- Next step is representation/feature diagnosis, not immediate rerun

## 5) Exact next action at home

1. Run platform/noise failure diagnosis on r4 scored-slice errors.
2. Design a compact platform/noise feature family targeting the false-positive mode.
3. Keep detector/taxonomy/labels/model family unchanged for that pass.
4. Do **not** rerun full Phase 5 before diagnosis + feature design pass is complete.

## 6) What not to touch

- Detector behavior
- Taxonomy
- Labels
- Springboard configuration (keep probe-r1)
- Broad new experiments outside platform/noise diagnosis/design
```

```
# Phase 5 Regime-Aware Freeze

Date: 2026-04-13

This file freezes the manifest lists and numeric guardbands for the first future regime-aware Phase 5 simulation run.

## Frozen manifest policy

1. Springboard track uses only `evaluation_insep_15min_validated` springboard rows for train/eval materialization and reserves Champigny springboard rows for validation stress only.
2. Platform/noise track uses only `evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui` platform/noise rows for train/eval materialization and reserves Champigny platform/noise rows for validation stress only.
3. Champigny is frozen as mixed-session validation primary role (`used_for_training: false` in this first run).
4. Materialization level is both session-level and row-level (`row_key` lists).

## Frozen guardbands (numeric)

- springboard success min: AUC >= `0.52` and macro F1 >= `0.5`
- platform/noise success min: AUC >= `0.66` and macro F1 >= `0.5`
- Champigny stress mins: springboard macro F1 >= `0.44`, platform/noise macro F1 >= `0.64`
- regression caps: springboard macro F1 drop <= `0.03`, platform/noise macro F1 drop <= `0.04`, Champigny drop <= `0.05`

## Frozen references

- `outputs/event_classifier_baseline_reviewed_anchorpropfix.json`
- `outputs/per_regime_baseline_split_analysis.json`

## Readiness

- After this freeze, protocol ambiguity is removed for manifest membership and numeric pass/fail thresholds.
- Next execution decision can be made against this frozen contract without redefining splits or guardbands.

## Revision r2 (2026-04-13)

- Tiny frozen-slice refinement applied for first rerun.
- Excluded `det-0001` and `det-0007` from Champigny platform/noise mixed validation slice.
- Final human labels and legacy subtypes kept unchanged.
- Guardbands, detector behavior, taxonomy, and model family unchanged.

## Revision r3prep (2026-04-13)

- Champigny mixed validation is now explicitly split into three frozen sub-slices:
  1. `springboard_scored_slice` (scored for springboard guardbands)
  2. `platform_only_stress_slice` (reporting-only)
  3. `ambiguity_slice` containing `det-0001` and `det-0007` (reporting-only)
- Added class-coverage gating for binary scored slices: min 2 classes present and at least 1 row per class.
- If gating fails, binary AUC/macro-F1 guardbands are marked `NOT_APPLICABLE_GATING_FAILED` and only reporting-only metrics are emitted.
- Labels, legacy subtypes, detector behavior, taxonomy, and numeric guardband definitions remain unchanged.

## Revision r4 (2026-04-13)

- Recovered valid two-class scored platform/noise validation slice from `insep_quick_stratified_holdout_candidate`.
- Scored slice composition frozen at 20 rows: 10 `platform_dive`, 10 `noise_or_other`, all proposal-centered.
- Leak prevention frozen: scored holdout rows are removed from platform/noise training rows.
- Champigny platform-only and ambiguity slices remain reporting-only.
- Springboard configuration remains r3 unchanged (probe-r1 features, same classifier family).
<exited with exit code 0>
```

 'prop_t': lambda r: float(r.get('proposal_timestamp_seconds') or 0.0),
 'start_t': lambda r: float(r.get('event_window_start_seconds') or 0.0),
 'is_fn_window': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('is_false_negative_window') else 0.0,
 'legacy_non_dive_subtype_handling': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_non_dive_subtype')=='handling_noise' else 0.0,
 'legacy_non_dive_subtype_whistle': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_non_dive_subtype')=='voice_whistle' else 0.0,
 'legacy_label_dive': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_candidate_label')=='dive' else 0.0,
 'legacy_label_non_dive': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_candidate_label')=='non_dive' else 0.0,
 'legacy_label_false_negative': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_candidate_label')=='false_negative' else 0.0,
}

# logistic functions

def std_fit(X):
    m=X.mean(axis=0); s=X.std(axis=0); s[s<1e-8]=1.0; return m,s

def std_apply(X,m,s): return (X-m)/s

def train(X,y,epochs=1000,lr=0.1,l2=0.01):
    n,d=X.shape; w=np.zeros(d); b=0.0
    for _ in range(epochs):
      z=X@w+b
      p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z,-40,40)))
      e=p-y
      gw=(X.T@e)/n + l2*w
      gb=e.mean()
      w-=lr*gw; b-=lr*gb
    return w,b

def pred(X,w,b):
    z=X@w+b
    p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z,-40,40)))
    return p

def label(rk):
    return mlabel[rk]

mlabel={rk:('platform_dive' if next(x for x in m['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows'] if x['row_key']==rk)['event_label']=='platform_dive' else 'noise_or_other') for rk in hold}
for rk in train_keys:
    # from train rows list labels
    mlabel[rk]=next(x for x in m['platform_noise_track']['train_rows'] if x['row_key']==rk)['event_label']

target=[[8,2],[9,1]]
best=[]
feat_names=list(feats.keys())
for r in range(1,5):
  for comb in itertools.combinations(feat_names,r):
    Xtr=np.array([[feats[f](by[k]) for f in comb] for k in train_keys],float)
    ytr=np.array([1.0 if mlabel[k]=='platform_dive' else 0.0 for k in train_keys],float)
    Xte=np.array([[feats[f](by[k]) for f in comb] for k in hold],float)
    yte=np.array([1.0 if mlabel[k]=='platform_dive' else 0.0 for k in hold],float)
    mm,ss=std_fit(Xtr)
    Xtr=std_apply(Xtr,mm,ss); Xte=std_apply(Xte,mm,ss)
    w,b=train(Xtr,ytr)
    p=pred(Xte,w,b)
    yh=(p>=0.5).astype(float)
    # cm rows [platform,noise], cols [platform,noise]
    tp=((yte==1)&(yh==1)).sum(); fn=((yte==1)&(yh==0)).sum(); fp=((yte==0)&(yh==1)).sum(); tn=((yte==0)&(yh==0)).sum()
    cm=[[int(tp),int(fn)],[int(fp),int(tn)]]
    dist=sum(abs(cm[i][j]-target[i][j]) for i in [0,1] for j in [0,1])
    if dist<=2:
      best.append((dist,comb,cm,p))

best=sorted(best,key=lambda x:x[0])
print('matches near target',len(best))
for dist,comb,cm,p in best[:15]:
  print('dist',dist,'comb',comb,'cm',cm)
  if cm==target:
    yh=(p>=0.5)
    fp=[hold[i] for i in range(len(hold)) if mlabel[hold[i]]=='noise_or_other' and yh[i]]
    fn=[hold[i] for i in range(len(hold)) if mlabel[hold[i]]=='platform_dive' and not yh[i]]
    tn=[hold[i] for i in range(len(hold)) if mlabel[hold[i]]=='noise_or_other' and not yh[i]]
    print('  fn',fn,'tn',tn)
    break

counts={}; by={}

    by[f"{sid}::{rid}"]=r

manifest=json.load(open('outputs/phase5_regime_manifest_lists.json'))
hold=manifest['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows']
train=manifest['platform_noise_track']['train_rows']
hold_keys=[x['row_key'] for x in hold]; train_keys=[x['row_key'] for x in train]
labels={x['row_key']:x['event_label'] for x in hold+train}

# reviewed manifest for suggestion reason
review_rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui/exports/event-reviewed-manifest/event_reviewed_manifest.jsonl') if l.strip()]
rev_by={f"evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui::{r['legacy_candidate_id']}":r for r in review_rows if r.get('legacy_candidate_id')}

# infer exact error sets from all 1-4 feature subset logistic models that match frozen confusion
feats={
 'audio_score': lambda r: float(r.get('audio_score') or 0.0),
 'clip_prob': lambda r: float(r.get('audio_clip_probability') or 0.0),
 'combined_score': lambda r: float(r.get('combined_score') or 0.0),
 'anchor_t': lambda r: float(r.get('event_anchor_timestamp_seconds') or 0.0),
 'start_t': lambda r: float(r.get('event_window_start_seconds') or 0.0),
 'is_fn_window': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('is_false_negative_window') else 0.0,

 'sub_whistle': lambda r: 1.0 if r.get('legacy_non_dive_subtype')=='voice_whistle' else 0.0,

}
def std_fit(X):
    m=X.mean(axis=0); s=X.std(axis=0); s[s<1e-8]=1.; return m,s

def train_log(X,y,epochs=1000,lr=0.1,l2=0.01):
    w=np.zeros(X.shape[1]); b=0.
    for _ in range(epochs):
        z=X@w+b; p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z,-40,40))); e=p-y
        w-=lr*((X.T@e)/len(X)+l2*w); b-=lr*e.mean()
    return w,b

def predict(comb):
    Xtr=np.array([[feats[f](by[k]) for f in comb] for k in train_keys])
    ytr=np.array([1 if labels[k]=='platform_dive' else 0 for k in train_keys],float)
    Xte=np.array([[feats[f](by[k]) for f in comb] for k in hold_keys])
    yte=np.array([1 if labels[k]=='platform_dive' else 0 for k in hold_keys],float)
    m,s=std_fit(Xtr); Xtr=(Xtr-m)/s; Xte=(Xte-m)/s
    w,b=train_log(Xtr,ytr)
    p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(Xte@w+b,-40,40)))
    yh=(p>=0.5)
    cm=[[int(((yte==1)&(yh==1)).sum()),int(((yte==1)&(~yh)).sum())],[int(((yte==0)&(yh==1)).sum()),int(((yte==0)&(~yh)).sum())]]
    fn=tuple(sorted([hold_keys[i] for i in range(len(hold_keys)) if labels[hold_keys[i]]=='platform_dive' and not yh[i]]))

    tn=tuple(sorted([hold_keys[i] for i in range(len(hold_keys)) if labels[hold_keys[i]]=='noise_or_other' and not yh[i]]))
    return cm,fn,fp,tn

for r in range(1,5):

fn_reason=Counter([x['suggestion_reason'] or 'null' for x in fn_rows])

platform_all=[k for k in hold_keys if labels[k]=='platform_dive']
noise_all=[k for k in hold_keys if labels[k]=='noise_or_other']

`peak_to_window_energy_ratio`\n+   - `attack_rise_ms`\n+   - `single_peak_dominance`\n+   - Purpose: suppress handling-noise FPs by requiring compact, dominant impact structure.\n+\n+2. **Broadband splash decay**\n+   - 6. **Ranked root-cause diagnosis**

3. noise heterogeneity  
4. simple model underfitting  
5. label ambiguity (lowest)

7. **Proposed platform/noise feature groups**

- impact compactness (peak concentration, attack rise, single-peak dominance)
- broadband splash decay (early-vs-tail decay, tail half-life)
- tonal vs broadband texture (tonal persistence, whistle-band fraction, spectral flatness)
- isolation vs diffuse clutter (transient count, inter-peak irregularity)

8. **Single best next action**

**A — derive a small new platform/noise feature family and rerun the same model** on the same frozen r4 holdout. This is the minimal justified step because the failure is representation-driven, not yet a model-family failure.

```
383. def _strongest_confusions(four_class_summary: dict, pairwise: dict) -> list[dict]:
384.     confusions: list[dict] = []
385.     for task_name, task in pairwise.items():
386.         if not task["folds"]:
387.             continue
388.         worst_fold = min(task["folds"], key=lambda fold: fold["accuracy"])
389.         confusions.append(
390.             {
391.                 "task": task_name,
392.                 "held_out_session": worst_fold["held_out_session"],
393.                 "accuracy": worst_fold["accuracy"],
394.                 "confusion_matrix": worst_fold["confusion_matrix"],
395.             }
396.         )
397.     if four_class_summary.get("available") and four_class_summary.get("confusion_matrix") is not None:
398.         confusions.append(
399.             {
400.                 "task": "four_class",
401.                 "confusion_matrix": four_class_summary["confusion_matrix"],
402.                 "macro_f1": four_class_summary["macro"]["f1"],
403.             }
404.         )
405.     return confusions

408. def _decision(pairwise: dict, four_class_summary: dict) -> str:
409.     springboard = pairwise["springboard_dive_vs_springboard_rebound_only"]
410.     platform = pairwise["platform_dive_vs_noise_or_other"]
411.     if springboard["mean_auc"] >= 0.75 and platform["mean_auc"] >= 0.70:
412.         if not four_class_summary.get("available") or four_class_summary["macro"]["f1"] >= 0.45:
413.             return "GO_PHASE_5"
414.     return "STOP_AND_ADDRESS_LABEL_GAPS"
```

import json,statistics
# build row mapping
rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/event_window_manifest_preview.jsonl') if l.strip()]
counts={}; by={}
for r in rows:
  sid=r['source_session_id']; counts[sid]=counts.get(sid,0)+1
  rid=r.get('legacy_candidate_id') or f"row-{counts[sid]:04d}"
  by[f"{sid}::{rid}"]=r
# reviewed_candidates map
rc=[json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui/exports/evaluation-review/reviewed_candidates.jsonl') if l.strip()]
rc_by={f"evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui::{r['source_candidate_id']}":r for r in rc if r.get('source_candidate_id')}
m=json.load(open('outputs/phase5_regime_manifest_lists.json'))
h=m['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows']
features=['clip_peak_to_tail_flux_ratio','clip_peak_to_tail_rms_ratio','clip_post_onset_decay_ratio','clip_flatness_mean','clip_centroid_mean','clip_pcen_high_band_ratio','clip_temporal_asymmetry_flux','clip_temporal_asymmetry_rms','clip_pcen_band_spread']

    (p if lab=='platform_dive' else n).append(float(v))

}

def std_fit(X):
 m=X.mean(0); s=X.std(0); s[s<1e-8]=1; return m,s

def train_log(X,y,epochs=1000,lr=0.1,l2=0.01):
 w=np.zeros(X.shape[1]); b=0.
 for _ in range(epochs):
  z=X@w+b; p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z,-40,40))); e=p-y
  w-=lr*((X.T@e)/len(X)+l2*w); b-=lr*e.mean()
 return w,b

def auc(y,s):

 pos=s[y==1]; neg=s[y==0]; total=len(pos)*len(neg)
 if total==0:return 0.5
 gt=sum((v>neg).sum() for v in pos); eq=sum((v==neg).sum() for v in pos)
 a=(gt+0.5*eq)/total
 return max(a,1-a)

  ytr=np.array([1 if labels[k]=='platform_dive' else 0 for k in train],float)

  yte=np.array([1 if labels[k]=='platform_dive' else 0 for k in hold],int)

  if cm==[[8,2],[9,1]]:

    prec_n=tn/(tn+fn); rec_n=tn/(tn+fp); f1n=2*prec_n*rec_n/(prec_n+rec_n)

```
20. def binary_auc(y_true: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float:
21.     pos = scores[y_true == 1]
22.     neg = scores[y_true == 0]
23.     total = len(pos) * len(neg)
24.     if total == 0:
25.         return 0.5
26.     gt = 0
27.     eq = 0
28.     for value in pos:
29.         diff = value - neg
30.         gt += int(np.sum(diff > 0))
31.         eq += int(np.sum(diff == 0))
32.     auc = (gt + 0.5 * eq) / total
33.     return float(max(auc, 1.0 - auc))

47. def train_binary_logreg(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, epochs: int = 1000, lr: float = 0.1, l2: float = 0.01) -> dict:
48.     n_samples, n_features = x.shape
49.     weights = np.zeros(n_features, dtype=np.float64)
50.     bias = 0.0
51.     for _ in range(epochs):
52.         logits = x @ weights + bias
53.         probs = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))
54.         error = probs - y
55.         grad_w = (x.T @ error) / n_samples + l2 * weights
56.         grad_b = float(np.mean(error))
57.         weights -= lr * grad_w
58.         bias -= lr * grad_b
59.     return {"weights": weights, "bias": bias}
60.

62. def predict_binary_logreg(model: dict, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
63.     logits = x @ model["weights"] + model["bias"]
64.     return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))

123. def framing(signal: np.ndarray, frame: int, hop: int) -> np.ndarray:
124.     if len(signal) < frame:
125.         padded = np.zeros(frame, dtype=np.float32)
126.         padded[: len(signal)] = signal
127.         return padded.reshape(1, frame)
128.     n_frames = 1 + (len(signal) - frame) // hop
129.     shape = (n_frames, frame)
130.     strides = (signal.strides[0] * hop, signal.strides[0])
131.     return np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(signal, shape=shape, strides=strides, writeable=False)

134. def local_peak_indices(values: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -> np.ndarray:
135.     if len(values) < 3:
136.         return np.asarray([], dtype=int)
137.     peaks = []
138.     for i in range(1, len(values) - 1):
139.         if values[i] >= values[i - 1] and values[i] >= values[i + 1] and values[i] >= threshold:
140.             peaks.append(i)
141.     return np.asarray(peaks, dtype=int)

144. def extract_platform_noise_audio_features(signal: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int) -> dict[str, float]:
145.     frame = 512
146.     hop = 128
147.     eps = 1e-8
148.     frames = framing(signal, frame=frame, hop=hop)
149.     if frames.size == 0:
150.         return {name: 0.0 for name in AUDIO_FEATURE_NAMES}
151.     window = np.hanning(frame).astype(np.float32)
152.     windowed = frames * window
153.     rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(windowed), axis=1) + eps)
154.     peak_idx = int(np.argmax(rms))
155.     peak_val = float(rms[peak_idx])
156.     mean_val = float(np.mean(rms))
157.     med_val = float(np.median(rms))
158.     std_val = float(np.std(rms))
159. 
160.     peak_threshold = mean_val + 0.5 * std_val
161.     peak_ids = local_peak_indices(rms, threshold=peak_threshold)
162.     transient_peak_count = float(len(peak_ids))
163.     if len(peak_ids) >= 3:
164.         intervals = np.diff(peak_ids).astype(np.float64)
165.         interval_cv = float(np.std(intervals) / max(np.mean(intervals), eps))
166.     else:
167.         interval_cv = 0.0
168. 
169.     # 120 ms and 600 ms windows after peak for decay contrast.
170.     frames_120 = max(1, int(round(0.120 * sample_rate / hop)))
171.     frames_600 = max(frames_120 + 1, int(round(0.600 * sample_rate / hop)))
172.     early = rms[peak_idx + 1 : peak_idx + 1 + frames_120]
173.     late = rms[peak_idx + 1 + frames_120 : peak_idx + 1 + frames_600]
174.     early_mean = float(np.mean(early)) if len(early) else 0.0
175.     late_mean = float(np.mean(late)) if len(late) else 0.0
176.     post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio = early_mean / max(late_mean, eps)
177. 
178.     half_level = 0.5 * peak_val
179.     tail = rms[peak_idx + 1 :]
180.     half_idx = next((i for i, value in enumerate(tail, start=1) if value <= half_level), len(tail))
181.     tail_half_life_ms = float(half_idx * hop * 1000.0 / sample_rate)
182. 
183.     spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(windowed, axis=1)) ** 2
184.     post_frames = spectrum[peak_idx : peak_idx + max(1, int(round(0.400 * sample_rate / hop)))]
185.     if len(post_frames) == 0:
186.         post_frames = spectrum[max(0, peak_idx - 1) : peak_idx + 1]
187.     power = np.maximum(post_frames, eps)
188.     spectral_flatness = np.exp(np.mean(np.log(power), axis=1)) / np.maximum(np.mean(power, axis=1), eps)
189.     spectral_flatness_post_mean = float(np.mean(spectral_flatness))
190.     tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean = float(np.mean(np.max(power, axis=1) / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1), eps)))
191. 
192.     return {
193.         "impact_peak_to_window_rms_ratio": peak_val / max(mean_val, eps),
194.         "impact_peak_prominence_db": 20.0 * math.log10(max(peak_val, eps) / max(med_val, eps)),
195.         "transient_peak_count": transient_peak_count,
196.         "inter_peak_interval_cv": interval_cv,
197.         "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio": post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio,
198.         "tail_half_life_ms": tail_half_life_ms,
199.         "spectral_flatness_post_mean": spectral_flatness_post_mean,
200.         "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean": tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean,
201.     }

244.     pred = np.asarray([1.0 if score >= 0.5 else 0.0 for score in scores], dtype=np.float64)
245. 
246.     tp = int(np.sum((y_hold == 1.0) & (pred == 1.0)))
247.     fn = int(np.sum((y_hold == 1.0) & (pred == 0.0)))
248.     fp = int(np.sum((y_hold == 0.0) & (pred == 1.0)))

250.     acc = float((tp + tn) / len(y_hold)) if len(y_hold) else 0.0
251.     auc = binary_auc(y_hold, scores)

253.     def prf_pos(tp_: int, fp_: int, fn_: int) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
254.         precision = tp_ / (tp_ + fp_) if tp_ + fp_ else 0.0
255.         recall = tp_ / (tp_ + fn_) if tp_ + fn_ else 0.0
256.         f1 = 2.0 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0
257.         return precision, recall, f1
```

import numpy as np

train=[(x['row_key'],x['event_label'],by[x['row_key']]) for x in lists['platform_noise_track']['train_rows']]
hold=[(x['row_key'],x['event_label'],by[x['row_key']]) for x in lists['platform_noise_track']['holdout_rows']]

sr=16000
cache={}

    if sid in cache: continue
    p=Path(row['source_session_root'])/'web'/'session_source_review.mp4'

    cache[sid]=np.frombuffer(proc.stdout,dtype=np.float32)

def framing(sig,frame=512,hop=128):
    if len(sig)<frame:
        pad=np.zeros(frame,dtype=np.float32); pad[:len(sig)]=sig; return pad.reshape(1,frame)
    n=1+(len(sig)-frame)//hop
    return np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(sig,shape=(n,frame),strides=(sig.strides[0]*hop,sig.strides[0]),writeable=False)

def loc_peaks(v,thr):
    out=[]
    for i in range(1,len(v)-1):
        if v[i]>=v[i-1] and v[i]>=v[i+1] and v[i]>=thr: out.append(i)
    return np.array(out,dtype=int)

def extract(sig):
    eps=1e-8; frame=512; hop=128
    fr=framing(sig,frame,hop)
    win=np.hanning(frame).astype(np.float32)
    w=fr*win
    rms=np.sqrt(np.mean(w*w,axis=1)+eps)
    pidx=int(np.argmax(rms)); pval=float(rms[pidx]); mean=float(rms.mean()); med=float(np.median(rms)); std=float(rms.std())
    pks=loc_peaks(rms,mean+0.5*std)
    ivcv=float(np.std(np.diff(pks))/max(np.mean(np.diff(pks)),eps)) if len(pks)>=3 else 0.0
    f120=max(1,round(0.12*sr/hop)); f600=max(f120+1,round(0.6*sr/hop))
    early=rms[pidx+1:pidx+1+f120]; late=rms[pidx+1+f120:pidx+1+f600]
    er=float(early.mean()) if len(early) else 0.; lr=float(late.mean()) if len(late) else 0.
    half=0.5*pval; tail=rms[pidx+1:]
    hidx=next((i for i,v in enumerate(tail,start=1) if v<=half),len(tail))
    spec=np.abs(np.fft.rfft(w,axis=1))**2
    post=spec[pidx:pidx+max(1,round(0.4*sr/hop))]
    if len(post)==0: post=spec[max(0,pidx-1):pidx+1]
    power=np.maximum(post,eps)
    flat=np.exp(np.mean(np.log(power),axis=1))/np.maximum(np.mean(power,axis=1),eps)
    tonal=np.max(power,axis=1)/np.maximum(np.sum(power,axis=1),eps)

    # r2 candidate refinements
    freqs=np.fft.rfftfreq(frame,d=1.0/sr)
    wb=(freqs>=1000)&(freqs<=4000)
    whistle_frac=float(np.mean(np.sum(power[:,wb],axis=1)/np.maximum(np.sum(power,axis=1),eps)))
    pnorm=power/np.maximum(np.sum(power,axis=1,keepdims=True),eps)
    ent=-np.sum(pnorm*np.log(np.maximum(pnorm,eps)),axis=1)/math.log(power.shape[1])
    spec_entropy=float(np.mean(ent))
    tonal_persist=float(np.mean(tonal>0.22))
    width=(rms>=0.7*pval).sum()*hop*1000.0/sr
    width50=(rms>=0.5*pval).sum()*hop*1000.0/sr

    return {
      'impact_peak_to_window_rms_ratio': pval/max(mean,eps),
      'impact_peak_prominence_db': 20*math.log10(max(pval,eps)/max(med,eps)),
      'transient_peak_count': float(len(pks)),
      'inter_peak_interval_cv': ivcv,
      'post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio': er/max(lr,eps),
      'tail_half_life_ms': float(hidx*hop*1000.0/sr),
      'spectral_flatness_post_mean': float(np.mean(flat)),
      'tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean': float(np.mean(tonal)),
      # candidates
      'whistle_band_energy_fraction_post': whistle_frac,
      'spectral_entropy_post_mean': spec_entropy,
      'tonal_persistence_ratio_post': tonal_persist,
      'impact_width_70pct_ms': float(width),
      'impact_width_50pct_ms': float(width50),
    }

ex={}
for key,_,row in train+hold:
    sig=cache[row['source_session_id']]
    a=max(0.0,float(row.get('event_window_start_seconds') or 0.0)); b=max(a+0.05,float(row.get('event_window_end_seconds') or 0.0))
    ex[key]=extract(sig[int(round(a*sr)):int(round(b*sr))])

probe1=['impact_peak_to_window_rms_ratio','impact_peak_prominence_db','transient_peak_count','inter_peak_interval_cv','post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio','tail_half_life_ms','spectral_flatness_post_mean','tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean']
cands=['whistle_band_energy_fraction_post','spectral_entropy_post_mean','tonal_persistence_ratio_post','impact_width_70pct_ms','impact_width_50pct_ms']

def basevec(row):
    return [float(row.get('audio_score') or 0.0),float(row.get('audio_clip_probability') or 0.0),float(row.get('event_anchor_timestamp_seconds') or 0.0),1.0 if row.get('is_false_negative_window') else 0.0]

def stdfit(X):
    m=X.mean(0); s=X.std(0); s[s<1e-8]=1; return m,s

def train_lr(X,y,epochs=1000,lr=0.1,l2=0.01):
    w=np.zeros(X.shape[1]); b=0.
    for _ in range(epochs):
        z=X@w+b; p=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(z,-40,40))); e=p-y
        w-=lr*((X.T@e)/len(X)+l2*w); b-=lr*e.mean()
    return w,b

def eval(extra_names):

    if len(sig)<frame:

scores=1/(1+np.exp(-np.clip(Xte@w+b,-40,40)))

hold_score=[]
for (k,lab,row),s in zip(hold_rows,scores.tolist()):
    hold_score.append({'row_key':k,'label':lab,'score_platform':float(s)})

wins=0; ties=0; total=len(pos)*len(neg)
for p in pos:

auc=(wins+0.5*ties)/total

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np


def load_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [json.loads(line) for line in path.read_text().splitlines() if line.strip()]


def build_row_key_map(rows: list[dict]) -> dict[str, dict]:
    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
    out: dict[str, dict] = {}
    for row in rows:
        sid = str(row["source_session_id"])
        counts[sid] = counts.get(sid, 0) + 1
        cid = row.get("legacy_candidate_id")
        rid = str(cid) if cid else f"row-{counts[sid]:04d}"
        out[f"{sid}::{rid}"] = row
    return out


def decode_audio(path: Path, sr: int) -> np.ndarray:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [
            "ffmpeg",
            "-nostdin",
            "-hide_banner",
            "-loglevel",
            "error",
            "-i",
            str(path),
            "-ac",
            "1",
            "-ar",
            str(sr),
            "-f",
            "f32le",
            "-",
        ],
        check=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
    )
    return np.frombuffer(proc.stdout, dtype=np.float32)


def framing(signal: np.ndarray, frame: int, hop: int) -> np.ndarray:
    if len(signal) < frame:
        padded = np.zeros(frame, dtype=np.float32)
        padded[: len(signal)] = signal
        return padded.reshape(1, frame)
    n_frames = 1 + (len(signal) - frame) // hop
    return np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(
        signal,
        shape=(n_frames, frame),
        strides=(signal.strides[0] * hop, signal.strides[0]),
        writeable=False,
    )


def peak_indices(values: np.ndarray, thr: float) -> np.ndarray:
    out = []
    for i in range(1, len(values) - 1):
        if values[i] >= values[i - 1] and values[i] >= values[i + 1] and values[i] >= thr:
            out.append(i)
    return np.asarray(out, dtype=int)


def extract_features(signal: np.ndarray, sr: int) -> dict[str, float]:
    eps = 1e-8
    frame = 512
    hop = 128
    frames = framing(signal, frame=frame, hop=hop)
    if frames.size == 0:
        return {
            "spectral_flatness_post_mean": 0.0,
            "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean": 0.0,
            "whistle_band_energy_fraction_post": 0.0,
            "spectral_entropy_post_mean": 0.0,
            "transient_peak_count": 0.0,
            "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio": 0.0,
        }
    window = np.hanning(frame).astype(np.float32)
    w = frames * window
    rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(w), axis=1) + eps)
    pidx = int(np.argmax(rms))
    mean = float(np.mean(rms))
    std = float(np.std(rms))

    peaks = peak_indices(rms, mean + 0.5 * std)

    f120 = max(1, int(round(0.12 * sr / hop)))
    f600 = max(f120 + 1, int(round(0.60 * sr / hop)))
    early = rms[pidx + 1 : pidx + 1 + f120]
    late = rms[pidx + 1 + f120 : pidx + 1 + f600]
    early_m = float(np.mean(early)) if len(early) else 0.0
    late_m = float(np.mean(late)) if len(late) else 0.0

    spec = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(w, axis=1)) ** 2
    post = spec[pidx : pidx + max(1, int(round(0.4 * sr / hop)))]
    if len(post) == 0:
        post = spec[max(0, pidx - 1) : pidx + 1]
    power = np.maximum(post, eps)

    flat = np.exp(np.mean(np.log(power), axis=1)) / np.maximum(np.mean(power, axis=1), eps)
    tonal = np.max(power, axis=1) / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1), eps)

    freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(frame, d=1.0 / sr)
    whistle_band = (freqs >= 1000.0) & (freqs <= 4000.0)
    whistle_frac = np.sum(power[:, whistle_band], axis=1) / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1), eps)

    pnorm = power / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1, keepdims=True), eps)
    entropy = -np.sum(pnorm * np.log(np.maximum(pnorm, eps)), axis=1) / math.log(power.shape[1])

    return {
        "spectral_flatness_post_mean": float(np.mean(flat)),
        "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean": float(np.mean(tonal)),
        "whistle_band_energy_fraction_post": float(np.mean(whistle_frac)),
        "spectral_entropy_post_mean": float(np.mean(entropy)),
        "transient_peak_count": float(len(peaks)),
        "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio": early_m / max(late_m, eps),
    }


def main() -> None:
    sr = 16000
    r6 = json.loads(Path("outputs/phase5_regime_aware_execution_r6.json").read_text())
    r2 = json.loads(Path("outputs/platform_noise_feature_probe_r2.json").read_text())
    mlist = json.loads(Path("outputs/phase5_regime_manifest_lists.json").read_text())

    manifest_rows = load_jsonl(Path("outputs/event_window_manifest_preview.jsonl"))
    by_key = build_row_key_map(manifest_rows)

    reviewed_rows = load_jsonl(
        Path("outputs/evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui/exports/event-reviewed-manifest/event_reviewed_manifest.jsonl")
    )
    reviewed_by_key = {
        f"evaluation_insep_quick_9015_20260409_ui::{row['legacy_candidate_id']}": row
        for row in reviewed_rows
        if row.get("legacy_candidate_id")
    }

    # Frozen r6 platform/noise state comes from accepted r2 probe integration.
    state = r2["three_way_comparison"]["probe_r2_feature_iteration"]
    fp_rows = list(state["false_positive_noise_to_platform_rows"])
    fn_rows = list(state["false_negative_platform_to_noise_rows"])

    train = [(x["row_key"], x["event_label"], by_key[x["row_key"]]) for x in mlist["platform_noise_track"]["train_rows"]]
    hold = [(x["row_key"], x["event_label"], by_key[x["row_key"]]) for x in mlist["platform_noise_track"]["holdout_rows"]]

    # Decode per-session audio once.
    audio_cache: dict[str, np.ndarray] = {}
    for key, label, row in train + hold:
        sid = str(row["source_session_id"])
        if sid not in audio_cache:
            audio_path = Path(str(row["source_session_root"])) / "web" / "session_source_review.mp4"
            audio_cache[sid] = decode_audio(audio_path, sr=sr)

    feature_map: dict[str, dict[str, float]] = {}
    for key, label, row in train + hold:
        signal = audio_cache[str(row["source_session_id"])]
        start = max(0.0, float(row.get("event_window_start_seconds") or 0.0))
        end = max(start + 0.05, float(row.get("event_window_end_seconds") or 0.0))
        s0 = int(round(start * sr))
        s1 = int(round(end * sr))
        feature_map[key] = extract_features(signal[s0:s1], sr=sr)

    # Rebuild model scores used in r2 for ranking analysis.
    base_names = [
        "audio_score",
        "audio_clip_probability",
        "event_anchor_timestamp_seconds",
        "is_false_negative_window",
    ]
    p1_names = [
        "impact_peak_to_window_rms_ratio",
        "impact_peak_prominence_db",
        "transient_peak_count",
        "inter_peak_interval_cv",
        "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio",
        "tail_half_life_ms",
        "spectral_flatness_post_mean",
        "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean",
    ]
    p2_names = ["whistle_band_energy_fraction_post", "spectral_entropy_post_mean"]

    # We only need score ordering and local patterns; reuse persisted r2 confusion identity.
    # Build synthetic vectors from available values: for missing p1 fields, take persisted r2 model behavior via score reconstruction.
    # Here we proxy with the same available platform/noise vectors used in r2 output identity.
    # For robust ranking explanation, we estimate score spread from logistic over base + (available) tonal features.
    def row_vec(row_key: str, row: dict) -> list[float]:
        return [
            float(row.get("audio_score") or 0.0),
            float(row.get("audio_clip_probability") or 0.0),
            float(row.get("event_anchor_timestamp_seconds") or 0.0),
            1.0 if row.get("is_false_negative_window") else 0.0,
            feature_map[row_key]["spectral_flatness_post_mean"],
            feature_map[row_key]["tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean"],
            feature_map[row_key]["whistle_band_energy_fraction_post"],
            feature_map[row_key]["spectral_entropy_post_mean"],
            feature_map[row_key]["transient_peak_count"],
            feature_map[row_key]["post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio"],
        ]

    xtr = np.asarray([row_vec(k, r) for k, lab, r in train], dtype=np.float64)
    ytr = np.asarray([1.0 if lab == "platform_dive" else 0.0 for k, lab, r in train], dtype=np.float64)
    xte = np.asarray([row_vec(k, r) for k, lab, r in hold], dtype=np.float64)

    mean = xtr.mean(axis=0)
    std = xtr.std(axis=0)
    std[std < 1e-8] = 1.0
    xtr = (xtr - mean) / std
    xte = (xte - mean) / std

    w = np.zeros(xtr.shape[1], dtype=np.float64)
    b = 0.0
    for _ in range(1000):
        z = xtr @ w + b
        p = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(z, -40.0, 40.0)))
        e = p - ytr
        w -= 0.1 * ((xtr.T @ e) / len(xtr) + 0.01 * w)
        b -= 0.1 * float(np.mean(e))

    scores = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(xte @ w + b, -40.0, 40.0)))
    hold_scores = []
    for (k, lab, row), s in zip(hold, scores.tolist()):
        hold_scores.append({"row_key": k, "label": lab, "score_platform": float(s)})

    pos = [x["score_platform"] for x in hold_scores if x["label"] == "platform_dive"]
    neg = [x["score_platform"] for x in hold_scores if x["label"] == "noise_or_other"]
    wins = 0
    ties = 0
    total = len(pos) * len(neg)
    for p in pos:
        for n in neg:
            if p > n:
                wins += 1
            elif p == n:
                ties += 1
    auc_pairwise = (wins + 0.5 * ties) / total if total else 0.5
    auc_pairwise = max(auc_pairwise, 1.0 - auc_pairwise)

    min_pos = min(pos)
    overlap_noise = [x for x in hold_scores if x["label"] == "noise_or_other" and x["score_platform"] >= min_pos]

    def enrich(row_key: str) -> dict:
        row = by_key[row_key]
        rev = reviewed_by_key.get(row_key, {})
        score = next(x["score_platform"] for x in hold_scores if x["row_key"] == row_key)
        return {
            "row_key": row_key,
            "legacy_subtype": rev.get("review_subtype") or row.get("legacy_non_dive_subtype"),
            "suggestion_reason": rev.get("suggested_event_label_reason"),
            "legacy_label": row.get("legacy_candidate_label"),
            "audio_score": row.get("audio_score"),
            "audio_clip_probability": row.get("audio_clip_probability"),
            "score_platform": score,
            "feature_snapshot": {
                "spectral_flatness_post_mean": feature_map[row_key]["spectral_flatness_post_mean"],
                "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean": feature_map[row_key]["tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean"],
                "whistle_band_energy_fraction_post": feature_map[row_key]["whistle_band_energy_fraction_post"],
                "spectral_entropy_post_mean": feature_map[row_key]["spectral_entropy_post_mean"],
                "transient_peak_count": feature_map[row_key]["transient_peak_count"],
                "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio": feature_map[row_key]["post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio"],
            },
        }

    fp_details = [enrich(k) for k in fp_rows]
    fn_details = [enrich(k) for k in fn_rows]

    def count_by(items: list[dict], key: str) -> dict[str, int]:
        out: dict[str, int] = {}
        for item in items:
            value = item.get(key)
            k = str(value) if value is not None else "null"
            out[k] = out.get(k, 0) + 1
        return out

    fp_sub = count_by(fp_details, "legacy_subtype")
    fn_sub = count_by(fn_details, "legacy_subtype")
    fp_reason = count_by(fp_details, "suggestion_reason")
    fn_reason = count_by(fn_details, "suggestion_reason")

    residual = {
        "scope": {
            "source_execution": "outputs/phase5_regime_aware_execution_r6.json",
            "platform_noise_slice_frozen": True,
            "classifier_family_unchanged": True,
            "phase5_rerun_performed": False,
        },
        "part_a_residual_error_audit": {
            "remaining_false_positives_noise_to_platform_count": len(fp_rows),
            "remaining_false_negatives_platform_to_noise_count": len(fn_rows),
            "false_positive_rows": fp_rows,
            "false_negative_rows": fn_rows,

```
36. @dataclass(frozen=True)
37. class RowRef:
38.     row_key: str
39.     label: str
40.     row: dict

42. 
43. def to_float(value, default: float = 0.0) -> float:
44.     try:
45.         if value is None:
46.             return float(default)
47.         if isinstance(value, bool):
48.             return 1.0 if value else 0.0
49.         return float(value)
50.     except Exception:
51.         return float(default)
52.

54. def decode_audio_mono(path: Path, sample_rate: int) -> np.ndarray:
55.     cmd = [
56.         "ffmpeg",
57.         "-nostdin",
58.         "-hide_banner",
59.         "-loglevel",
60.         "error",
61.         "-i",
62.         str(path),
63.         "-ac",
64.         "1",
65.         "-ar",
66.         str(sample_rate),
67.         "-f",
68.         "f32le",
69.         "-",
70.     ]
71.     proc = subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE)
72.     return np.frombuffer(proc.stdout, dtype=np.float32)
73. 
74. 
75. def framing(signal: np.ndarray, frame: int, hop: int) -> np.ndarray:
76.     if len(signal) < frame:
77.         padded = np.zeros(frame, dtype=np.float32)
78.         padded[: len(signal)] = signal
79.         return padded.reshape(1, frame)
80.     n_frames = 1 + (len(signal) - frame) // hop
81.     shape = (n_frames, frame)
82.     strides = (signal.strides[0] * hop, signal.strides[0])
83.     return np.lib.stride_tricks.as_strided(signal, shape=shape, strides=strides, writeable=False)
84. 
85. 
86. def local_peak_indices(values: np.ndarray, threshold: float) -> np.ndarray:
87.     if len(values) < 3:
88.         return np.asarray([], dtype=int)
89.     peaks = []
90.     for i in range(1, len(values) - 1):
91.         if values[i] >= values[i - 1] and values[i] >= values[i + 1] and values[i] >= threshold:
92.             peaks.append(i)
93.     return np.asarray(peaks, dtype=int)
94. 
95. 
96. def extract_probe_features(signal: np.ndarray, sample_rate: int) -> dict[str, float]:
97.     frame = 512
98.     hop = 128
99.     eps = 1e-8
100.     frames = framing(signal, frame=frame, hop=hop)
101.     if frames.size == 0:
102.         return {name: 0.0 for name in PROBE1_FEATURE_NAMES + R2_REFINEMENT_FEATURES}
103. 
104.     window = np.hanning(frame).astype(np.float32)
105.     windowed = frames * window
106.     rms = np.sqrt(np.mean(np.square(windowed), axis=1) + eps)
107.     peak_idx = int(np.argmax(rms))
108.     peak_val = float(rms[peak_idx])
109.     mean_val = float(np.mean(rms))
110.     med_val = float(np.median(rms))
111.     std_val = float(np.std(rms))
112. 
113.     peak_threshold = mean_val + 0.5 * std_val
114.     peak_ids = local_peak_indices(rms, threshold=peak_threshold)
115.     transient_peak_count = float(len(peak_ids))
116.     if len(peak_ids) >= 3:
117.         intervals = np.diff(peak_ids).astype(np.float64)
118.         interval_cv = float(np.std(intervals) / max(np.mean(intervals), eps))
119.     else:
120.         interval_cv = 0.0
121. 
122.     frames_120 = max(1, int(round(0.120 * sample_rate / hop)))
123.     frames_600 = max(frames_120 + 1, int(round(0.600 * sample_rate / hop)))
124.     early = rms[peak_idx + 1 : peak_idx + 1 + frames_120]
125.     late = rms[peak_idx + 1 + frames_120 : peak_idx + 1 + frames_600]
126.     early_mean = float(np.mean(early)) if len(early) else 0.0
127.     late_mean = float(np.mean(late)) if len(late) else 0.0
128.     post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio = early_mean / max(late_mean, eps)
129. 
130.     half_level = 0.5 * peak_val
131.     tail = rms[peak_idx + 1 :]
132.     half_idx = next((i for i, value in enumerate(tail, start=1) if value <= half_level), len(tail))
133.     tail_half_life_ms = float(half_idx * hop * 1000.0 / sample_rate)
134. 
135.     spectrum = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(windowed, axis=1)) ** 2
136.     post_frames = spectrum[peak_idx : peak_idx + max(1, int(round(0.400 * sample_rate / hop)))]
137.     if len(post_frames) == 0:
138.         post_frames = spectrum[max(0, peak_idx - 1) : peak_idx + 1]
139.     power = np.maximum(post_frames, eps)
140.     spectral_flatness = np.exp(np.mean(np.log(power), axis=1)) / np.maximum(np.mean(power, axis=1), eps)
141.     tonal_peak_fraction = np.max(power, axis=1) / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1), eps)
142. 
143.     # r2 refinement: stronger tonal-vs-broadband separation for whistle-like residual FPs.
144.     freqs = np.fft.rfftfreq(frame, d=1.0 / sample_rate)
145.     whistle_band = (freqs >= 1000.0) & (freqs <= 4000.0)
146.     whistle_band_energy_fraction_post = float(
147.         np.mean(np.sum(power[:, whistle_band], axis=1) / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1), eps))
148.     )
149.     pnorm = power / np.maximum(np.sum(power, axis=1, keepdims=True), eps)
150.     spectral_entropy = -np.sum(pnorm * np.log(np.maximum(pnorm, eps)), axis=1) / math.log(power.shape[1])
151.     spectral_entropy_post_mean = float(np.mean(spectral_entropy))
152. 
153.     return {
154.         "impact_peak_to_window_rms_ratio": peak_val / max(mean_val, eps),
155.         "impact_peak_prominence_db": 20.0 * math.log10(max(peak_val, eps) / max(med_val, eps)),
156.         "transient_peak_count": transient_peak_count,
157.         "inter_peak_interval_cv": interval_cv,
158.         "post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio": post_impact_early_to_late_rms_ratio,
159.         "tail_half_life_ms": tail_half_life_ms,
160.         "spectral_flatness_post_mean": float(np.mean(spectral_flatness)),
161.         "tonal_peak_fraction_post_mean": float(np.mean(tonal_peak_fraction)),
162.         "whistle_band_energy_fraction_post": whistle_band_energy_fraction_post,
163.         "spectral_entropy_post_mean": spectral_entropy_post_mean,
164.     }
165.

167. def standardize_fit(x: np.ndarray) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
168.     mean = x.mean(axis=0)
169.     std = x.std(axis=0)
170.     std[std < 1e-8] = 1.0
171.     return mean, std
172. 
173. 
174. def standardize_apply(x: np.ndarray, mean: np.ndarray, std: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
175.     return (x - mean) / std
176. 
177. 
178. def train_binary_logreg(x: np.ndarray, y: np.ndarray, epochs: int = 1000, lr: float = 0.1, l2: float = 0.01) -> dict:
179.     n_samples, n_features = x.shape
180.     weights = np.zeros(n_features, dtype=np.float64)
181.     bias = 0.0
182.     for _ in range(epochs):
183.         logits = x @ weights + bias
184.         probs = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))
185.         error = probs - y
186.         grad_w = (x.T @ error) / n_samples + l2 * weights
187.         grad_b = float(np.mean(error))
188.         weights -= lr * grad_w
189.         bias -= lr * grad_b
190.     return {"weights": weights, "bias": bias}
191. 
192. 
193. def predict_binary_logreg(model: dict, x: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
194.     logits = x @ model["weights"] + model["bias"]
195.     return 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(logits, -40.0, 40.0)))
196. 
197. 
198. def binary_auc(y_true: np.ndarray, scores: np.ndarray) -> float:
199.     pos = scores[y_true == 1]
200.     neg = scores[y_true == 0]
201.     total = len(pos) * len(neg)
202.     if total == 0:
203.         return 0.5
204.     gt = 0
205.     eq = 0
206.     for value in pos:
207.         diff = value - neg
208.         gt += int(np.sum(diff > 0))
209.         eq += int(np.sum(diff == 0))
210.     auc = (gt + 0.5 * eq) / total
211.     return float(max(auc, 1.0 - auc))
212. 
213. 
214. def evaluate(train: list[RowRef], holdout: list[RowRef], feature_map: dict[str, dict[str, float]]) -> dict:
215.     def vec(item: RowRef) -> list[float]:
216.         row = item.row
217.         return [
218.             to_float(row.get("audio_score")),
219.             to_float(row.get("audio_clip_probability")),
220.             to_float(row.get("event_anchor_timestamp_seconds")),
221.             1.0 if row.get("is_false_negative_window") else 0.0,
222.             *[to_float(feature_map[item.row_key][name]) for name in PROBE1_FEATURE_NAMES],
223.             *[to_float(feature_map[item.row_key][name]) for name in R2_REFINEMENT_FEATURES],
224.         ]
225. 
226.     x_train = np.asarray([vec(item) for item in train], dtype=np.float64)
227.     y_train = np.asarray([1.0 if item.label == "platform_dive" else 0.0 for item in train], dtype=np.float64)
228.     x_hold = np.asarray([vec(item) for item in holdout], dtype=np.float64)
229.     y_hold = np.asarray([1.0 if item.label == "platform_dive" else 0.0 for item in holdout], dtype=np.float64)
230. 
231.     mean, std = standardize_fit(x_train)
232.     x_train = standardize_apply(x_train, mean, std)
233.     x_hold = standardize_apply(x_hold, mean, std)
234.     model = train_binary_logreg(x_train, y_train)
235.     scores = predict_binary_logreg(model, x_hold)
236.     pred = np.asarray([1.0 if score >= 0.5 else 0.0 for score in scores], dtype=np.float64)
237. 
238.     tp = int(np.sum((y_hold == 1.0) & (pred == 1.0)))
239.     fn = int(np.sum((y_hold == 1.0) & (pred == 0.0)))
240.     fp = int(np.sum((y_hold == 0.0) & (pred == 1.0)))
241.     tn = int(np.sum((y_hold == 0.0) & (pred == 0.0)))
242.     acc = float((tp + tn) / len(y_hold)) if len(y_hold) else 0.0
243.     auc = binary_auc(y_hold, scores)
244. 
245.     def f1_for(tp_: int, fp_: int, fn_: int) -> tuple[float, float, float]:
246.         precision = tp_ / (tp_ + fp_) if tp_ + fp_ else 0.0
247.         recall = tp_ / (tp_ + fn_) if tp_ + fn_ else 0.0
248.         f1 = 2.0 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0.0
249.         return precision, recall, f1
250. 
251.     _, rec_platform, f1_platform = f1_for(tp, fp, fn)
252.     _, rec_noise, f1_noise = f1_for(tn, fn, fp)
```

<sub>⏱️ 68m 16s</sub>

### 👤 User

Good. The platform/noise feature probe r3 is accepted as a negative result.

Keep these conclusions fixed:
	•	platform/noise probe r2 remains the best accepted feature family so far
	•	r3 regressed relative to r2
	•	the single derived tonal_noise_penalty feature is not sufficient to solve the remaining ranking gap
	•	the residual false positives are a mixed cluster (handling_noise, voice_whistle, and one ambiguous/null row), so the remaining problem is broader than tonal suppression alone
	•	do NOT carry r3 forward
	•	do NOT rerun full Phase 5 yet

Do NOT change detector behavior.
Do NOT change taxonomy.
Do NOT change review labels.
Do NOT change springboard.
Do NOT change classifier family.

Objective

Run a platform/noise residual-cluster feature-design pass to determine whether there is one final coherent feature bundle worth testing beyond r2, before deciding on Phase 5 r7.

Use both:
	•	the local residual-error evidence from r6/r3
	•	external official/primary references for sound-event/audio feature design

This is an analysis/design pass only.

Required outputs

Create:
	•	outputs/platform_noise_r3_postmortem.json
	•	outputs/platform_noise_r3_postmortem.md
	•	outputs/platform_noise_final_feature_candidates.json
	•	outputs/platform_noise_final_feature_candidates.md

Required work

Part A — R3 postmortem

Explain exactly why r3 likely failed.

At minimum cover:
	•	why tonal_noise_penalty was too narrow
	•	what kinds of residual rows it could not separate
	•	whether it introduced redundant or destabilizing information relative to the accepted r2 set

Part B — Residual-cluster characterization

Using the current accepted r2 error set, characterize the remaining 6 false positives and 2 false negatives as a cluster problem.

Be explicit about:
	•	which rows are mainly tonal
	•	which are mainly diffuse handling/noise
	•	which are ambiguous mixed-profile cases

Part C — Online-informed feature design

Using official/primary sources, propose a small final candidate bundle of features that is more coherent than the single r3 penalty.

Prioritize features along these lines if justified by the sources and local error pattern:
	•	spectral contrast / peak-vs-valley structure
	•	onset-density / local autocorrelation / tempogram-style rhythm clues
	•	compactness / isolation vs diffuse clutter
	•	broadband-vs-tonal separation

For each proposed feature, explain:
	•	what it is
	•	why it maps to the residual failure cluster
	•	whether it is likely derivable from current audio/windows

Part D — Go / no-go decision

Answer clearly with one of:
	•	FINAL_PLATFORM_NOISE_R4_FEATURE_BUNDLE_JUSTIFIED

```
Contents of https://librosa.org/doc/main/generated/librosa.feature.spectral_contrast.html:
Caution

You're reading the documentation for a development version. For the latest released version, please have a look at [0.11.0](../../0.11.0/index.html).

librosa.feature.spectral\_contrast(_\*_, _y\=None_, _sr\=22050_, _S\=None_, _n\_fft\=2048_, _hop\_length\=512_, _win\_length\=None_, _window\='hann'_, _center\=True_, _pad\_mode\='constant'_, _freq\=None_, _fmin\=200.0_, _n\_bands\=6_, _quantile\=0.02_, _linear\=False_)[\[source\]](../_modules/librosa/feature/spectral.html#spectral_contrast)[](#librosa.feature.spectral_contrast "Permalink to this definition")

Compute spectral contrast

Each frame of a spectrogram `S` is divided into sub-bands. For each sub-band, the energy contrast is estimated by comparing the mean energy in the top quantile (peak energy) to that of the bottom quantile (valley energy). High contrast values generally correspond to clear, narrow-band signals, while low contrast values correspond to broad-band noise. [\[1\]](#id2)

Parameters:

**y**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, n)\] or None

audio time series. Multi-channel is supported.

**sr**number > 0 \[scalar\]

audio sampling rate of `y`

**S**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, d, t)\] or None

(optional) spectrogram magnitude

**n\_fft**int > 0 \[scalar\]

FFT window size

**hop\_length**int > 0 \[scalar\]

hop length for STFT. See [`librosa.stft`](librosa.stft.html#librosa.stft "librosa.stft") for details.

**win\_length**int <= n\_fft \[scalar\]

Each frame of audio is windowed by _window()_. The window will be of length _win\_length_ and then padded with zeros to match `n_fft`. If unspecified, defaults to `win_length = n_fft`.

**window**string, tuple, number, function, or np.ndarray \[shape=(n\_fft,)\]

*   a window specification (string, tuple, or number); see [`scipy.signal.get_window`](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.signal.get_window.html#scipy.signal.get_window "(in SciPy v1.15.3)")
    
*   a window function, such as [`scipy.signal.windows.hann`](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.signal.windows.hann.html#scipy.signal.windows.hann "(in SciPy v1.15.3)")
    
*   a vector or array of length `n_fft`
    

**center**boolean

*   If _True_, the signal `y` is padded so that frame `t` is centered at `y[t * hop_length]`.
    
*   If _False_, then frame `t` begins at `y[t * hop_length]`
    

**pad\_mode**string

If `center=True`, the padding mode to use at the edges of the signal. By default, STFT uses zero padding.

**freq**None or np.ndarray \[shape=(d,)\]

Center frequencies for spectrogram bins. If _None_, then FFT bin center frequencies are used. Otherwise, it can be a single array of `d` center frequencies.

**fmin**float > 0

Frequency cutoff for the first bin `[0, fmin]` Subsequent bins will cover ``[fmin, 2*fmin]`, `[2*fmin, 4*fmin]``, etc.

**n\_bands**int > 1

number of frequency bands

**quantile**float in (0, 1)

quantile for determining peaks and valleys

**linear**bool

If _True_, return the linear difference of magnitudes: `peaks - valleys`. If _False_, return the logarithmic difference: `log(peaks) - log(valleys)`.

Returns:

**contrast**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, n\_bands + 1, t)\]

each row of spectral contrast values corresponds to a given octave-based frequency

Examples

\>>> y, sr \= librosa.load(librosa.ex('trumpet'))
\>>> S \= np.abs(librosa.stft(y))
\>>> contrast \= librosa.feature.spectral\_contrast(S\=S, sr\=sr)

\>>> import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
\>>> fig, ax \= plt.subplots(nrows\=2, sharex\=True)
\>>> img1 \= librosa.display.specshow(librosa.amplitude\_to\_db(S,
...                                                  ref\=np.max),
...                          y\_axis\='log', x\_axis\='time', ax\=ax\[0\])
\>>> fig.colorbar(img1, ax\=\[ax\[0\]\], format\='%+2.0f dB')
\>>> ax\[0\].set(title\='Power spectrogram')
\>>> ax\[0\].label\_outer()
\>>> img2 \= librosa.display.specshow(contrast, x\_axis\='time', ax\=ax\[1\])
\>>> fig.colorbar(img2, ax\=\[ax\[1\]\])
\>>> ax\[1\].set(ylabel\='Frequency bands', title\='Spectral contrast')

![../_images/librosa-feature-spectral_contrast-1.png](../_images/librosa-feature-spectral_contrast-1.png)
```

```
Contents of https://librosa.org/doc/main/generated/librosa.feature.tempogram.html:
[librosa](../index.html)

Caution

You're reading the documentation for a development version. For the latest released version, please have a look at [0.11.0](../../0.11.0/index.html).

librosa.feature.tempogram(_\*_, _y\=None_, _sr\=22050_, _onset\_envelope\=None_, _hop\_length\=512_, _win\_length\=384_, _center\=True_, _window\='hann'_, _norm\=inf_)[\[source\]](../_modules/librosa/feature/rhythm.html#tempogram)[](#librosa.feature.tempogram "Permalink to this definition")

Compute the tempogram: local autocorrelation of the onset strength envelope. [\[1\]](#id2)

Parameters:

**y**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, n)\] or None

Audio time series. Multi-channel is supported.

**sr**number > 0 \[scalar\]

sampling rate of `y`

**onset\_envelope**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, n) or (…, m, n)\] or None

Optional pre-computed onset strength envelope as provided by [`librosa.onset.onset_strength`](librosa.onset.onset_strength.html#librosa.onset.onset_strength "librosa.onset.onset_strength").

If multi-dimensional, tempograms are computed independently for each band (first dimension).

**hop\_length**int > 0

number of audio samples between successive onset measurements

**win\_length**int > 0

length of the onset autocorrelation window (in frames/onset measurements) The default settings (384) corresponds to `384 * hop_length / sr ~= 8.9s`.

**center**bool

If _True_, onset autocorrelation windows are centered. If _False_, windows are left-aligned.

**window**string, function, number, tuple, or np.ndarray \[shape=(win\_length,)\]

A window specification as in _stft_.

**norm**{np.inf, -np.inf, 0, float > 0, None}

Normalization mode. Set to _None_ to disable normalization.

Returns:

**tempogram**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, win\_length, n)\]

Localized autocorrelation of the onset strength envelope.

If given multi-band input (`onset_envelope.shape==(m,n)`) then `tempogram[i]` is the tempogram of `onset_envelope[i]`.

Raises:

ParameterError

if neither `y` nor `onset_envelope` are provided

if `win_length < 1`

Examples

\>>> \# Compute local onset autocorrelation
\>>> y, sr \= librosa.load(librosa.ex('nutcracker'), duration\=30)
\>>> hop\_length \= 512
\>>> oenv \= librosa.onset.onset\_strength(y\=y, sr\=sr, hop\_length\=hop\_length)
\>>> tempogram \= librosa.feature.tempogram(onset\_envelope\=oenv, sr\=sr,
...                                       hop\_length\=hop\_length)
\>>> \# Compute global onset autocorrelation
\>>> ac\_global \= librosa.autocorrelate(oenv, max\_size\=tempogram.shape\[0\])
\>>> ac\_global \= librosa.util.normalize(ac\_global)
\>>> \# Estimate the global tempo for display purposes
\>>> tempo \= librosa.feature.tempo(onset\_envelope\=oenv, sr\=sr,
...                               hop\_length\=hop\_length)\[0\]

\>>> import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
\>>> fig, ax \= plt.subplots(nrows\=4, figsize\=(10, 10))
\>>> times \= librosa.times\_like(oenv, sr\=sr, hop\_length\=hop\_length)
\>>> ax\[0\].plot(times, oenv, label\='Onset strength')
\>>> ax\[0\].label\_outer()
\>>> ax\[0\].legend(frameon\=True)
\>>> librosa.display.specshow(tempogram, sr\=sr, hop\_length\=hop\_length,
\>>>                          x\_axis\='time', y\_axis\='tempo', cmap\='magma',
...                          ax\=ax\[1\])
\>>> ax\[1\].axhline(tempo, color\='w', linestyle\='--', alpha\=1,
...             label\='Estimated tempo={:g}'.format(tempo))
\>>> ax\[1\].legend(loc\='upper right')
\>>> ax\[1\].set(title\='Tempogram')
\>>> x \= np.linspace(0, tempogram.shape\[0\] \* float(hop\_length) / sr,
...                 num\=tempogram.shape\[0\])
\>>> ax\[2\].plot(x, np.mean(tempogram, axis\=1), label\='Mean local autocorrelation')
\>>> ax\[2\].plot(x, ac\_global, '--', alpha\=0.75, label\='Global autocorrelation')
\>>> ax\[2\].set(xlabel\='Lag (seconds)')
\>>> ax\[2\].legend(frameon\=True)
\>>> freqs \= librosa.tempo\_frequencies(tempogram.shape\[0\], hop\_length\=hop\_length, sr\=sr)
\>>> ax\[3\].semilogx(freqs\[1:\], np.mean(tempogram\[1:\], axis\=1),
...              label\='Mean local autocorrelation', base\=2)
\>>> ax\[3\].semilogx(freqs\[1:\], ac\_global\[1:\], '--', alpha\=0.75,
...              label\='Global autocorrelation', base\=2)
\>>> ax\[3\].axvline(tempo, color\='black', linestyle\='--', alpha\=.8,
...             label\='Estimated tempo={:g}'.format(tempo))
\>>> ax\[3\].legend(frameon\=True)
\>>> ax\[3\].set(xlabel\='BPM')
\>>> ax\[3\].grid(True)

![../_images/librosa-feature-tempogram-1.png](../_images/librosa-feature-tempogram-1.png)
```

```
Contents of https://librosa.org/doc/main/generated/librosa.onset.onset_strength.html:
Caution

You're reading the documentation for a development version. For the latest released version, please have a look at [0.11.0](../../0.11.0/index.html).

librosa.onset.onset\_strength(_\*_, _y\=None_, _sr\=22050_, _S\=None_, _lag\=1_, _max\_size\=1_, _ref\=None_, _detrend\=False_, _center\=True_, _feature\=None_, _aggregate\=None_, _\*\*kwargs_)[\[source\]](../_modules/librosa/onset.html#onset_strength)[](#librosa.onset.onset_strength "Permalink to this definition")

Compute a spectral flux onset strength envelope.

Onset strength at time `t` is determined by:

mean\_f max(0, S\[f, t\] \- ref\[f, t \- lag\])

where `ref` is `S` after local max filtering along the frequency axis [\[1\]](#id2).

By default, if a time series `y` is provided, S will be the log-power Mel spectrogram.

Parameters:

**y**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, n)\]

audio time-series. Multi-channel is supported.

**sr**number > 0 \[scalar\]

sampling rate of `y`

**S**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, d, m)\]

pre-computed (log-power) spectrogram

**lag**int > 0

time lag for computing differences

**max\_size**int > 0

size (in frequency bins) of the local max filter. set to _1_ to disable filtering.

**ref**None or np.ndarray \[shape=(…, d, m)\]

An optional pre-computed reference spectrum, of the same shape as `S`. If not provided, it will be computed from `S`. If provided, it will override any local max filtering governed by `max_size`.

**detrend**bool \[scalar\]

Filter the onset strength to remove the DC component

**center**bool \[scalar\]

Shift the onset function by `n_fft // (2 * hop_length)` frames. This corresponds to using a centered frame analysis in the short-time Fourier transform.

**feature**function

Function for computing time-series features, eg, scaled spectrograms. By default, uses [`librosa.feature.melspectrogram`](librosa.feature.melspectrogram.html#librosa.feature.melspectrogram "librosa.feature.melspectrogram") with `fmax=sr/2`

**aggregate**function

Aggregation function to use when combining onsets at different frequency bins.

Default: `np.mean`

**\*\*kwargs**additional keyword arguments

Additional parameters to `feature()`, if `S` is not provided.

Returns:

**onset\_envelope**np.ndarray \[shape=(…, m,)\]

vector containing the onset strength envelope. If the input contains multiple channels, then onset envelope is computed for each channel.

Raises:

ParameterError

if neither `(y, sr)` nor `S` are provided

or if `lag` or `max_size` are not positive integers

Examples

First, load some audio and plot the spectrogram

\>>> import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
\>>> y, sr \= librosa.load(librosa.ex('trumpet'), duration\=3)
\>>> D \= np.abs(librosa.stft(y))
\>>> times \= librosa.times\_like(D, sr\=sr)
\>>> fig, ax \= plt.subplots(nrows\=2, sharex\=True)
\>>> librosa.display.specshow(librosa.amplitude\_to\_db(D, ref\=np.max),
...                          y\_axis\='log', x\_axis\='time', ax\=ax\[0\], sr\=sr)
\>>> ax\[0\].set(title\='Power spectrogram')
\>>> ax\[0\].label\_outer()

Construct a standard onset function

\>>> onset\_env \= librosa.onset.onset\_strength(y\=y, sr\=sr)
\>>> ax\[1\].plot(times, 2 + onset\_env / onset\_env.max(), alpha\=0.8,
...            label\='Mean (mel)')

Median aggregation, and custom mel options

\>>> onset\_env \= librosa.onset.onset\_strength(y\=y, sr\=sr,
...                                          aggregate\=np.median,
...                                          fmax\=8000, n\_mels\=256)
\>>> ax\[1\].plot(times, 1 + onset\_env / onset\_env.max(), alpha\=0.8,
...            label\='Median (custom mel)')

Constant-Q spectrogram instead of Mel

\>>> C \= np.abs(librosa.cqt(y\=y, sr\=sr))
\>>> onset\_env \= librosa.onset.onset\_strength(sr\=sr, S\=librosa.amplitude\_to\_db(C, ref\=np.max))
\>>> ax\[1\].plot(times, onset\_env / onset\_env.max(), alpha\=0.8,
...          label\='Mean (CQT)')
\>>> ax\[1\].legend()
\>>> ax\[1\].set(ylabel\='Normalized strength', yticks\=\[\])

![../_images/librosa-onset-onset_strength-1.png](../_images/librosa-onset-onset_strength-1.png)
```

```
Contents of https://essentia.upf.edu/reference/std_SpectralContrast.html:
standard mode | Spectral category

## Inputs[¶](#inputs "Link to this heading")

> *   `spectrum` (_vector\_real_) - the audio spectrum
>     

## Outputs[¶](#outputs "Link to this heading")

> *   `spectralContrast` (_vector\_real_) - the spectral contrast coefficients
>     
> *   `spectralValley` (_vector\_real_) - the magnitudes of the valleys
>     

## Parameters[¶](#parameters "Link to this heading")

> *   `frameSize` (_integer ∈ \[2, ∞), default = 2048_) :
>     
>     the size of the fft frames
>     
> *   `highFrequencyBound` (_real ∈ (0, ∞), default = 11000_) :
>     
>     the upper bound of the highest band
>     
> *   `lowFrequencyBound` (_real ∈ (0, ∞), default = 20_) :
>     
>     the lower bound of the lowest band
>     
> *   `neighbourRatio` (_real ∈ (0, 1\], default = 0.4_) :
>     
>     the ratio of the bins in the sub band used to calculate the peak and valley
>     
> *   `numberBands` (_integer ∈ (0, ∞), default = 6_) :
>     
>     the number of bands in the filter
>     
> *   `sampleRate` (_real ∈ (0, ∞), default = 22050_) :
>     
>     the sampling rate of the audio signal
>     
> *   `staticDistribution` (_real ∈ \[0, 1\], default = 0.15_) :
>     
>     the ratio of the bins to distribute equally
>     

## Description[¶](#description "Link to this heading")

This algorithm computes the Spectral Contrast feature of a spectrum. It is based on the Octave Based Spectral Contrast feature as described in \[1\]. The version implemented here is a modified version to improve discriminative power and robustness. The modifications are described in \[2\].

References:

\[1\] D.-N. Jiang, L. Lu, H.-J. Zhang, J.-H. Tao, and L.-H. Cai, “Music type classification by spectral contrast feature,” in IEEE International Conference on Multimedia and Expo (ICME’02), 2002, vol. 1, pp. 113–116.

\[2\] V. Akkermans, J. Serrà, and P. Herrera, “Shape-based spectral contrast descriptor,” in Sound and Music Computing Conference (SMC’09), 2009, pp. 143–148.

## Source code[¶](#source-code "Link to this heading")

> *   [C++ source code](https://github.com/MTG/essentia/blob/v2.1_beta5-1389-g36ec3d92/src/algorithms/spectral/spectralcontrast.cpp)
>     
> *   [C++ header file](https://github.com/MTG/essentia/blob/v2.1_beta5-1389-g36ec3d92/src/algorithms/spectral/spectralcontrast.h)
>     

## See also[¶](#see-also "Link to this heading")

SpectralContrast [(streaming)](streaming_SpectralContrast.html)
```

Good. The platform/noise feature probe r4 is accepted as a major representation result.

Keep these conclusions fixed:
	•	the final r4 feature bundle produced a strong platform/noise ranking gain:
